schema:name: Secure / Controlled Access
schema:description: For sensitive or regulated data requiring a controlled secure environment. No raw data download permitted; strict credentialing and auditing apply.
schema:text: By requesting access to this dataset, you agree to hold verified human-data or ethics credentials linked to your ORCID profile, comply with the FAIR² Data Use Agreement (DUA), work exclusively within the approved secure or federated environment, refrain from re-identification or raw data extraction, permit full audit logging, cite and acknowledge the dataset and its creators, preserve metadata and provenance, and avoid any redistribution outside the FAIR² or sovereign hosting environment. Only aggregated or anonymized outputs may leave the secure system.
